name: arcs
description: Design arcs, arches, circles, domes and other curved forms in a browser editor and build them from microbricks at your ghost brick.
author: Gameboard-dev

port.description: Port the editor's page is served on.

bind.description: Address to listen on. 127.0.0.1 is this machine only; 0.0.0.0 lets other players reach the editor.

url.description: Address players are told to open, if not http://localhost:<port> (for example a public host name).

max-bricks.description: Most bricks one build may place.

max-extent.description: Longest brick edge in microbricks (the game refuses more than 80).

asset-tetrahedron.description: Brick asset for the right-angled tetrahedron.

asset-cut-cube.description: Brick asset for the cube with that tetrahedron removed.

asset-hip.description: Brick asset for the hip: a quarter of a square pyramid, used on a pyramid's ridges.

mask-ramp.description: Which corners of its box the ramp asset fills when unrotated (see docs/calibration.md).

mask-tetrahedron.description: The same for the tetrahedron asset.

mask-cut-cube.description: The same for the cut-cube asset.

mask-hip.description: The same for the hip asset. Not yet checked in the game: one of 87, 117, 55 or 115 (see docs/calibration.md).

commands.name: /arc
commands.description: Get your link to the editor.

commands.name: /arc calibrate
commands.description: Place test bricks that show whether the mask settings match the game.
